# Popescu Robotics

> Reflections on AI, Robotics, and Stability — George Popescu's personal perspective on artificial intelligence, humanoid robotics, and long-term company building.

An informational site collecting George Popescu's personal reflections on artificial intelligence, humanoid robotics, and the importance of stability for long-term company building. Opinions only, not advice or services.

- [Home](https://popescurobotics.com/): Overview of core themes
- [About George Popescu](https://popescurobotics.com/about.html): Background and experience
- [Insights](https://popescurobotics.com/insights.html): Articles and reflections
- [Contact](https://popescurobotics.com/contact.html): Get in touch
